description: Trigger and behavior evals for the generative-film skill: co-design, casting lockups, shot-list validation, cost gating, generation, continuity QA, and assembly.

tests.prompt: I want to make a short film with Grok
grading_criteria: Skill triggers on generative film request
Starts with Phase 1 co-design (logline, runtime, look book, audio strategy)
States the projected generation cost before any shots are written
Does not skip to generating clips

tests.prompt: Storyboard this scene into shots I can generate
grading_criteria: Skill triggers on storyboard/shot-list request
Produces shots.yaml rows with size, angle, move, screen_dir, duration, and edit points
Runs shot_check.py and resolves blockers before proposing generation

tests.prompt: Turn chapter one of my goblin book into a film
grading_criteria: Skill triggers on adaptation request
Follows storycraft-handoff: imports the story bible rather than re-running co-design
Surfaces added visual canon (features the book never described) for user approval
Never edits the storycraft stories repo

tests.prompt: My character's face keeps changing between clips
grading_criteria: Skill triggers on continuity drift
Diagnoses generation mode first (text vs reference) per casting.md
Recommends locked lockups and reference plates, not prompt tinkering
Suggests trimming within handles before paying for a re-take
Runs estimate_cost.py and reports the projected spend before generating
Requires explicit confirmation (--yes) before spending
Refuses to exceed budget_usd rather than warning and proceeding
Does not fabricate generated clips
Detects missing XAI_API_KEY and falls back to packet mode
States plainly that prompts were written, not clips generated
Does not present packet output as finished film

tests.prompt: Write me a short story about a goblin
grading_criteria: Routes to storycraft, not filmcraft — no film is being produced
Plain ffmpeg task; no shot list, generation, or film production involved
